name: planning_agent
description: Syncs the service graph, then turns a requirement or bug report into a downloadable technical design doc.

triggers.name: repos
triggers.description:
One service per line: 'name: org/repo' or 'name: org/repo@branch'. Example:
orders: myorg/orders-service
payment: myorg/payment-service@develop

triggers.name: top_k
triggers.description: How many top-matching services to seed the search with (default 5).

triggers.name: hops
triggers.description: How many CALLS-graph hops to expand from the seed services (default 2).
